issue.title: Opt-in backfill of the period-note tree for 2023-2025 dailies (bob periods migrate -s 2023-01-02)

task_type_fields.proposal: Extend the period-note tree back to the 2023-2025 daily notes on Bryan's explicit opt-in: run `bob periods migrate -s 2023-01-02` as a dry run, review what it would create, adopt, and re-parent (including the existing zorg-index year notes 2024.md and 2025.md, which `bob periods list -p` currently reports as unscaffolded or stale-instructions info rows), then apply it with `-a` as one verified vault_rewrite commit and confirm `bob periods list -p` shows no dangling_daily_parent or missing_period_note rows for those years. Ledger data starts 2026-05-28, so backfilled weeks render as not tracked rather than zero. Proposed by bob-cli-gh.9 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The bob-cli-gh plan scoped migration to the ISO-2026 tree and made older backfill opt-in; rewriting about three years of daily-note parents is a vault-wide change Bryan has to choose explicitly.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-gh.9 proposed extending the ISO-2026 period-note tree to older daily notes, which the epic left opt-in.

payload.description: Proposed by bob-cli-gh.9 rollout; extends bob periods migrate beyond the ISO-2026 tree
